mainEntity.name: How long will my exterior paint job last in Oregon’s weather?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most exterior paint jobs last 8–12 years in the Pacific Northwest. With premium coatings, proper prep, and weather-aware timing, many Pemble Painting projects last even longer. Our 1-Year Inspection Guarantee adds extra assurance.

mainEntity.name: Do you help homeowners choose colors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. Every project includes a Free Professional Color Consultation to help you pick the right colors, finishes, and combinations for your space.

mainEntity.name: What’s the best time of year to avail a property painting service?

acceptedAnswer.text: We paint year-round when conditions support proper curing. For exterior projects, we monitor temperature, humidity, and dew point to ensure ideal adhesion. Interior painting is great any time.

mainEntity.name: How do you protect my home during the painting process?

acceptedAnswer.text: We cover floors, furniture, plants, and fixtures before prep begins. Our crews work clean, stay organized, and keep your home protected from start to finish.

mainEntity.name: What surfaces do you paint?

acceptedAnswer.text: We paint interior walls, trim, ceilings, cabinets, exterior siding, stucco, wood surfaces, decks, fences, and more. Each surface receives its own tailored prep and coating system for durability.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose paint colors that actually improve my home's atmosphere?

acceptedAnswer.text: Color psychology plays a huge role in how spaces feel and function. Fall colors especially can create warmth and comfort during Oregon's darker months. Explore professional color selection in our fall paint colors psychology guide.

mainEntity.name: What paints work best for Oregon's humid climate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Moisture-resistant formulations are essential for our Pacific Northwest conditions to prevent peeling, mildew, and premature failure. Learn about climate-specific paint selection in our moisture-resistant paint guide for local homes.
